internal version followed by total breech extraction
outcome: Cesarean delivery rate for the second twin
cohort: 2,256 cephalic second twins born after vaginal birth of the first twin at or after 32 weeks of gestation
finding: Internal version followed by total breech extraction of cephalic second twins was not associated with better neonatal outcomes than pushing.
mod_finding: Internal version followed by total breech extraction was associated with shorter intertwin delivery intervals and lower cesarean delivery rates for the second twin compared to pushing.
